trust_decision.summary: How much decompressed output an attacker-chosen zip/gzip report attachment may produce is decided (not at all at the pinned commit) inside extract_report(): an unbounded zip member .read() and an unbounded one-shot zlib.decompress().

landing_point.why: The advisory names extract_report() and gzip/zip attachments, and it is the only function in the tree that calls zipfile/zlib (parsedmarc/__init__.py:1212, parsedmarc/__init__.py:1215).

fix_sites.entry_point: public API parsedmarc.extract_report() (also reached by parse_report_file / parse_report_email / parse_aggregate_report_file, the CLI and mailbox watchers)
public API parsedmarc.extract_report() (same callers; gzip branch, includes application/tlsrpt+gzip parts)
fix_sites.module_kind: core parser, gzip branch; new helper _decompress_gzip_bounded added in the same file (fix.diff:90-127)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Every decompression call in the package is in extract_report (parsedmarc/__init__.py:1212, parsedmarc/__init__.py:1215); no second implementation, wrapper-side inflate or lower-level API exists at the pinned commit.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No route is left to dismiss: all callers (parsedmarc/__init__.py:1247, :1307, :2057, :2085, :2261) funnel through the single fixed function, so capping extract_report closes everything.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate compressed reports up to exactly the limit must still be extracted; bytes trailing a gzip member must still be ignored; a truncated gzip stream must still raise ParserError (a naive decompressobj swap silently accepts truncation); plain XML/JSON pass-through is unchanged.

O6_input_shapes: seekable and non-seekable binary file objects (parsedmarc/__init__.py:1186-1209)
MIME attachment payloads (application/tlsrpt+gzip and generic base64 attachments, parsedmarc/__init__.py:2056-2057, :2080-2085)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An application/tlsrpt+gzip branch that inflates the part itself with gzip.decompress() instead of calling extract_report.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The TLS-RPT content type is gzip-specific, so a maintainer could plausibly special-case it inline next to the tlsrpt+json branch at :2051-2054.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: parse_email() (a separate simplified email parser in another module) decompressing gzip/zip attachments to show them inline.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: utils.parse_email already handles attachments and payload stripping; a second inline inflate there would be a real second implementation at distance from extract_report.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Reading every zip member (or concatenating members) instead of only namelist()[0], so a per-member cap without a total cap is a how-type gap.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Some reporters send multi-file zips; iterating members is a natural feature request.
